definition: Protective stop beyond the last swing low (long) or high (short) plus a buffer of its price, the buffer read from the evidence each bar.
boundaries: A stand-in stop until the risk session writes the real exits. The buffer is a number that may move, so this version reads it from the evidence and keeps the make value only as the seed; version 1 held the make value and ignored a moved one.
recognition: The stop sits just beyond the last confirmed swing low (long) or high (short), moved with the buffer a number that moves feeds it.

sources.quote: Placeholder blocks are ordinary blocks whose entry says `origin: placeholder` and names the risk session as owner
A block reads every number from `evidence`; `make` only seeds.
